name: The Spirit Engine 2
storyline: An extensive plot spanning nine distinct chapters. History is unravelling in the once peaceful state of Lereftain. Murderous cults are running unchecked through the streets, parliament is bickering, tension is building with old enemies in the west and the country's inhuman rulers seem to be losing control of the situation. Three citizens who find their paths crossing in an act of charity one dark night will find themselves burdened with the responsibility of not only defending the nation but deciding whether to save civilisation as they know it.
summary: Sequel to The Spirit Engine, this is a strong improvement on the original game's formula. Form a three person party out of nine available characters, and uncover the secrets of both the world you're exploring and your own party members.
